title: Gift Bundles
statement: A shop has n gifts with prices. Return how many different bundles (sets of gifts, each gift used at most once) cost exactly budget. Gifts are different items even when their prices are equal.

answerKey.pattern: Backtracking over take or skip, with pruning
keyPoints: For each gift, branch on taking it or skipping it
Count a bundle when all gifts are decided and the total equals the budget
Prune when the running total passes the budget
edgeCases: Equal prices count as different gifts
The whole set is the only bundle
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Dynamic programming over totals: O(n · budget)

hints: Every gift is either in the bundle or not. How many bundles are there to check?
2ⁿ, one per take-or-skip choice for each gift. Backtracking walks them.
Recurse on (index, total): take gift i or skip it; count when index reaches n with total equal to the budget; stop early when total exceeds it.
